answer: The "Proof of Activity" (PoA) mechanism resists Sybil attacks by requiring AI agents to expend computational resources, akin to digging through ferrous soil, to solve complex puzzles. This process is analogous to navigating a karst landscape, where agents must adapt to varying terrain to reach the oasis of consensus. An attacker would need to expend significant computational power to create multiple identities, increasing the cost of a Sybil attack.
